milestones.title: Planning adopted, records migrated, repository restructured
Core DAG orchestration and configuration schemas
F1 and F1b conformance, India wiring

phases.summary: A-01/A-02/A-03/A-05/A-08/A-09/A-11/U-05 (schema)/U-07 (field) implemented; A-04, A-06, A-10, A-11, A-12, U-01 to U-06, V-02 to V-08 and Section 9 pass (loaders for technologies.yaml and experiments.yaml; seeds recorded in the manifest; ZZZ runs F1 to F8 in CI; batching under memory.max_batch_gb); A-07 implemented (every raster is COG; the 0.01 degree display layers of COMMAND 70 are written by the same writer since COMMAND 73; Parquet tables carry schema_version); A-13 partial (143 Implements lines). A-02 records the METHODOLOGY version, the times, the fingerprints and, since manifest 2.7 (D-core-048), the peak memory per phase and the files of F2b and F3 one by one. OQ-032 closed (D-core-018). CountryParams requirement is per-phase (D-core-013); default country-run expansion still parameters.json-only, unowned.

M-F1-03/M-F1-07 closed; M-F1-04 resource channel acquired (F-3). M-F1-05 code+tests done, OQ-038 resolved (retry/timeout policy, D-F1-019), M-F1-05 ERA5 gust acquired, registered and F1b-audited for BRA/PRT/IND (D-F1-022/023, 2026-10-06; OQ-029/OQ-037 closed). M-F1-02 passes. OQ-012/024/027/028 closed. F5-1 done: GEM trackers pinned (snapshot 2026-08-09) and clipped per country, validation-only (V-06 tests); GEM replaces GPPD for F7b (D-F1-026).

GWA products moved to real inspection. Weibull-A/k CRS gap fixed. IND parameters.json filled, F1b runs clean (0 alerts). CMIP6 resource channel (GFDL-ESM4/MIROC6) moved out of not_audited, 0 alerts, BRA/PRT/IND clean. ERA5 audited 2026-10-06 (0.25 deg, 0 alerts, BRA/PRT/IND); GEM still not_audited.

Green for PRT (93,215 px), IND (2.78M px) and BRA (7.10M px) with the contiguous territory (METHODOLOGY 15.2.0, D-F2a-021: largest polygon plus polygons within 1 km; elevation and slope from GLO-30, one source, no displacement; the bundled elevation file is not read), uncapped distances plus flags, per-height wind, geodesic slope, windowed reprojection, keyed clip caches. V-01 refrozen on ZZZ (G-4, then twice more for new layers). Land cover as per-class sample counts and slope as 30 m bin counts from Copernicus GLO-30 (M-F2a-06/07, D-F2a-015/016). See D-F2a-004..016.

H-5 and H-6 done (D-F2b-006): one map per exclusion and cost layer; statistics of the 12 layers for PRT, BRA and IND against sanity ranges (PVOUT from audit.yaml; air density from ISO 2533 and the 30 m DEM with a 5% quality-control tolerance (D-F1b-015); distances from the country bounding box); 0 pixels outside in PRT, BRA and IND. MS-4 closed on 2026-10-27 (COMMAND 72): its gate (exclusion parity E1-E3; sanity ranges pass for three countries) is met by the statistics above and the exclusion parity of D-F2b-005, and OQ-053, the only item that held it open, was closed on 2026-10-16. H-4 done and wired: phase siting_layers writes 12 physical-unit layers (no normalization). Exclusions E1-E6 (H-3) blocked on Stage R; legacy suitability_criteria still registered but not in the default run (D-F2b-005).

F3 runs end to end on the synthetic country (D-F3-011, I-4). Clean rerun of the three countries on 2026-10-08 (D-F3-009): three named land scenarios (central, restrictive, permissive) with a candidate-set stability table; IND land cover from the exact 10 m tiles (hardly different from the 100 m round). Central solar / wind eligible land PRT 23.8 / 31.7%, IND 4.8 / 16.2%, BRA 18.1 / 25.8% (cells tables of the round of 2026-10-26; the round of 2026-10-08 had IND 4.9 / 17.2%, before OQ-060 and the contiguous mask). Not built: the full-factorial range report. Source quality is in LIMITATIONS and OPEN_QUESTIONS (OQ-047 Tier 3 density, OQ-049 unsourced ranges, L-020), not in the run status; literature for the density, discharge and solar-slope upper ends is pending (Stage R). COMMAND 46 (D-F3-016): wind cells above 3000 m are not candidates in any scenario (OQ-058). F3 ran again in PRT, IND and BRA on 2026-10-17 (D-F3-017): PRT identical, IND wind changed, BRA wind lost one candidate with no DEM elevation. OQ-060 closed on 2026-10-18 (D-F3-018): a cell without elevation is not a candidate for either technology, reason missing_elevation; F3 ran again in the three countries (solar of IND and BRA lose 14 and 1 central cells). The E1 of IND no longer depends on the origin of the grid (D-F3-020; 2026-10-20, COMMAND 58) and the caches of the shares are keyed by the code that computes them (D-F3-021, COMMAND 59).

F4 runs on the synthetic country from miniature CMIP6 files (D-F4-019, D13b). J-1 to J-5 done: ensemble decided (option C, 36 members), forcing.parquet with masked cell-members (OQ-042 option C), members.yaml, hazard_context.parquet for the core window, one map per member; all wired in main.py. Re-run for BRA, PRT, IND under the MIROC6 wind exclusion (D-F4-024, 2026-10-14). Open: ISIMIP3b 2071-2100 hazard data not acquired, loss functions (OQ-007). Figures (COMMAND 68, docs/figures/migration_68.md): every figure of this phase is drawn through MapFigure and redrawn for BRA, PRT and IND; the old files are in archive/figures_20261026.

F5 is built and conformant on the synthetic country (pure functions, CF models, class flag, aggregates, pipeline, PhaseSpec technical_potential). Group 1 values and the IEA 3.4-130 curve are recorded (METHODOLOGY 15.0.1, D-F5-023, D-F5-025, D-F5-026). First complete real round, 2026-10-17 (D-F5-027): F3 run again in the three countries, then F5 in PRT, IND and BRA in one round, with the 150 m wind sensitivity and, for IND, the sensitivity with the cells above 3000 m. Every sanity check passed in the three countries and the F5 log has no warning, so F5 is ran_clean in PRT, IND and BRA. Plausibility is reported in the run report and nothing was adjusted. OQ-060 (cells with no DEM elevation) was closed on 2026-10-18 (METHODOLOGY 15.0.2, D-F3-018, D-F5-028): such a cell is not a candidate for either technology; F3 and F5 ran again in the three countries, every check passed again and the F5 log has no warning, so F5 stays ran_clean in PRT, IND and BRA. Report: docs/phases/F5/run_report_real.md; hashes: the content hashes of the manifest (D-core-042; the file of byte hashes run_real_hashes.json was removed on 2026-10-27). potential_maps writes the COG rasters and the T-R1 figure under settings.yaml figures, and (2026-10-19, D-F5-029, METHODOLOGY 15.1.0) the maps of capacity and energy per cell and per state with classes from the data, 48 maps for PRT, IND and BRA, with the sum checks against the F5 totals (docs/phases/F5/potential_maps_absolute.md). F1 to F5 ran again on 2026-10-19 with the contiguous mask and the GLO-30 elevation (COMMAND 55, METHODOLOGY 15.2.0, `docs/phases/core/geometry_dem_55.md`): rc 0 and no warning in PRT, IND and BRA, every sanity check of 49b passed, and the F5 totals changed as recorded in D-F5-031 (IND central solar 728.4 to 753.3 GW). F1 to F5 ran again on 2026-10-20 (COMMANDS 58, 59 and 60; `docs/phases/core/resume_integrity_58.md`, `docs/phases/F5/potential_maps_v2.md`): the manifest records a code fingerprint per phase and a canonical content hash per artifact (D-core-042), the F3 shares of the protected areas and lakes no longer depend on the origin of the grid (D-F3-020) and their caches follow the code (D-F3-021), the GWA files are completed from the neighbours to the mask (D-F1-030); rc 0, no warning and every sanity check of 49b passed in PRT, IND and BRA, the F5 totals moved by 0.1% or less. potential_maps now draws the densities per cell and per state with circles for the totals in the common map style (D-F5-032, METHODOLOGY 15.2.2; 20 files per country, the earlier figures archived). F5 is not in run.target_phases. Final round of COMMAND 62 (2026-10-21/22; `docs/phases/core/resume_integrity_58.md` section 10): F1 to F5 ran again in PRT and BRA with every internal cache rebuilt (keys with the code, D-core-043), rc 0, no warning, all 15 checks of 49b passed, totals within 0.1% of 2026-10-19; IND ran to F5 with the same result; its hazard_context and overview ran on 2026-10-25 after the ERA5 extension (D-F1-031: 20 years, no NaN of fg10 in the mask, coverage 99.94%). Figures (COMMAND 68, docs/figures/migration_68.md): every figure of this phase is drawn through MapFigure and redrawn for BRA, PRT and IND; the old files are in archive/figures_20261026. Figures of the questions of the thesis (COMMAND 69, docs/figures/questions_69.md): supply curves, land interval, change by SSP and window and the country comparison, drawn by potential_maps and by main.py (comparison), redrawn for BRA, PRT and IND. Wind CF per pixel (COMMAND 74, 2026-10-28, METHODOLOGY 15.3.0, D-F5-038, L-004; `docs/phases/F5/wind_cf_pixel_74.md`): the wind capacity factor is computed on every eligible 0.01 degree pixel and aggregated to the cell by the eligible area, solar unchanged; F3, F4 and F5 ran again in PRT, IND and BRA, 16 of 16 checks pass, the central wind energy moved by -0.0006%, +0.024% and +0.133%.

Kernel, summaries, design matrix, supply curves, nominal LCOE of the restrictive and permissive scenarios, PhaseSpec, U-04 convergence phase on the definitive MR of F7 and the lcoe_maps support phase built; ZZZ F1-F7b runs at 0.05 and 0.1 degree. Group 2 and the discount rate are recorded (METHODOLOGY 15.0.0, D-F6-021, D-F6-022). BRA/PRT/IND still fail loud for the Group 3 values and the degradation (OQ-001, OQ-019: degradation_rate, grid_cost_usd_per_mw_km, substation_cost_usd_per_mw, road_cost_usd_per_km). Conformance verified on synthetic countries only, until the first real run.

F7 built and tested on the synthetic country at 0.05 and 0.1 degree: energy floor in the kernel, two-pass evaluator and sample-major pass, classes, rankings, H1-H5 statistics with the pre-registered rules read from experiments.yaml (H1 to H5 registered; null: warning, no verdict), cross_country_h4 for the H4 verdict, H5 tables h5_summary and h5_members (fixed economic domain, target, exposure), PRIM scenario discovery with the pre-registered box choice and bootstrap (prim_box, prim_bootstrap), T-R10, T-R12, own PRIM checked against ema_workbench, MR against SR, robustness_maps. BRA/PRT/IND fail loud (F6 items plus cf_min). Waits for the real values and the author's decision parameters (OQ-008, OQ-010, OQ-021, OQ-051). Conformance verified on synthetic countries only, until the first real run.

F7b built and tested on the synthetic country (synthetic inventory with hand-computable units): excluded share at the plant pixels through F3's eligibility engine, enrichment in LCOE deciles, published-estimate table (empty, OQ-057), unit table, V-06 guards. BRA/PRT/IND fail loud listing the missing inputs (inventory, F3, F5, F6). Conformance verified on synthetic countries only, until the first real run.

Reader, names, style, provenance and runner built; scripts for every T-ID of Section 10 (T-M1 to T-O3) run on the synthetic country as a test build; the real thesis build waits for the real F5 to F7b runs and the author's values (OQ-008, OQ-010, OQ-021, OQ-051). Conformance verified on synthetic countries only, until the first real run.
